source_caption_text:
Cardi B brought “AH HA” to NPR’s Tiny Desk with a live-band rendition of her latest hit 🔥🎤 

The performance gave the track a different feel while keeping her signature energy and delivery.

Released on July 31, 2026, “AH HA” debuted at No. 25 on the Billboard Hot 100 and No. 5 on Hot R&B/Hip-Hop Songs. The single followed her sophomore album Am I the Drama? and was produced by DJ SwanQo, who also worked on “Up.” 📈 (power106.com, pitchfork.com)

It also entered Hot Rap Songs at No. 3, marking Cardi’s 30th top 10 on that chart. (billboard.com)

For her Tiny Desk debut, Cardi included “AH HA” alongside records like “Up” and “Bodak Yellow,” bringing different eras of her catalog into the same set. From the studio version to a full band behind her, the song made the transition to the desk 🔥👏 

How are you feeling this version compared to the original? 👀

Via: @nprmusic
